outcome: time to regain first bowel sound
cohort: All patients undergoing caesarean section were included in the study.
finding: Non-closure of the peritoneum at caesarean section reduces the length of hospital stay and the intensity of postoperative pain.
mod_finding: Non-closure of the peritoneum during caesarean section was associated with a lower need for additional analgesics, faster return of first bowel sounds, reduced intensity of postoperative pain, and a shorter length of hospital stay compared to peritoneal closure.
